summary.text: Donnie Ownby is an independent candidate who describes himself as a 69-year-old, semi-retired Christian conservative and Army veteran. He is running on congressional term limits, manufacturing and the working class, and education.

paragraphs.text: Donnie Ownby served in the U.S. Army from 1974 to 1977, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a high school diploma from Clinton High School and an associate degree from Roane State Community College.
He says his varied work experience includes military service, power line construction, transportation, X-ray and ultrasound technology, and running his own small trucking company.
Ownby says he is 69, semi-retired, and lives off the grid, and that he is married with a daughter, two living sons, and grandchildren.
He also says he has followed politics since middle school but had not sought office until now.
